description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm`, which is responsible for rendering HTML forms for configuration settings in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for building the form UI, fetching CSS and JavaScript resources, and handling individual form elements for different data types. Additionally, it contains related classes that serve as decorators and specialized renderers for form fields.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm
classes.description: Main class for rendering configuration forms including handling directives and rendering them in HTML with optional documentation links and styling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_bool
classes.description: Renderer for boolean configuration options, presented as radio buttons.
